provenance.data_source: real twin_manager version histories built in exp8_recovery_strategy.py:build_history(); deltas derived from consecutive real snapshots
provenance.implementation_note: twin_manager stores FULL SNAPSHOTS only — no checkpoint interval, no delta store, no inverse-delta application. Both recovery strategies are implemented in THIS EXPERIMENT, not in the production twin manager. Algorithm 2's branching must NOT be described as implemented in twin_manager.

delta_vs_snapshot_ratio.note: degenerate: every field changes every version, so a delta IS a full snapshot and delta encoding saves nothing

eq36_validation.conclusion: Eq (36) u = min{n-k, q} is VALID AS AN UPPER BOUND and INVALID AS AN EQUALITY. Checkpoint restore costs (k mod q) delta applications, not q; q is the supremum over k, attained only in the worst case. The exact cost is u = min{n-k, k mod q}. The manuscript should state Eq (36) as u <= min{n-k, q}, or replace it with the exact form.
